features: The earphones use large size dynamic drivers, bringing you immersive, vibrant and extraordinarily details.

The earphones have a built-in microphone and touch buttons, giving you full control over calls, media, and voice assistants with intuitive navigation.
Works seamlessly with mobile phones, laptops, and tablets for immersive music whenever and wherever.
